body_html:
Based in Athens, Georgia, DJ OS3 brings energy, passion, and creativity to every event he performs. Since starting his professional DJ career in 2023, Oscar has entertained crowds at weddings, family reunions, and release parties—always focused on elevating each celebration and creating lasting memories for his clients.

Oscar’s love for music started early, inspired by the game DJ Hero when he was just eight years old. That spark quickly turned into a genuine passion for DJing and emceeing. Even before owning his first set of equipment, he found creative ways to mix music and hone his skills—proof that his dedication to the craft runs deep.

You’ll find a wide variety of sounds in his headphones, from Rap and R&B to EDM, Dancehall, and Pop. His favorite events to perform are weddings, reunions, and school dances—anywhere he can connect with the crowd and keep the energy high all night long.

Outside of DJing, Oscar also enjoys music production, content creation, and video editing. When he’s not behind the decks, he’s often in the studio, at the gym, or gaming.

We’re proud to have DJ OS3 as part of the Jammin’ DJs team, bringing his talent and energy to every celebration.
